video_title: I played THIS OR THAT with the Thompson Twins! | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen and Ausar Thompson on their record-breaking rookie-scale contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: it's fun that I got to do it with him, but there's still a lot of work

text_blocks.speaker: Ausar Thompson
text_blocks.text: It's super cool. It's fun that I got to do it with him, but there's still a lot of work to be done and I'm excited for what's next in the future and if we could break some more records.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Break some more records. I like that confidence. Amen, are you picking up the check for dinner or is that going over to Ausar?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: That goes to little bro. I was the blueprint and he got to follow, so he got to pick up the check. He got a little more, so he got to pick it up.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's goals for the upcoming Houston Rockets season
quotes.excerpt: I want to get back on all-defensive team obviously. I want to help Houston get a championship
quotes.quote: I want to get back on all-defensive team obviously. I didn't make it last year. I want to help Houston get a championship. I just want to be the best player I can be.

quotes.speaker: Ausar Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ausar Thompson's goals for the upcoming Detroit Pistons season
quotes.excerpt: I want to be all-defense, all-NBA, want a championship, bring a championship to Detroit
quotes.quote: I want to be all-defense, all-NBA, want a championship, bring a championship to Detroit, hopefully with Houston and that. That would be great. That would be enough for me.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen and Ausar Thompson debate who is the better defender
quotes.excerpt: I got to give it to him right now just because he just made first team

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Who is the better defender, Amen, you or your brother?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: I got to give it to him right now just because he just made first team.

text_blocks.speaker: Ausar Thompson
text_blocks.text: I mean, I'm the better defender.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thompson twins on how they started calling each other 'twin'
quotes.excerpt: once we got to NBA everybody started calling us twin so we would like troll

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: I heard that before you guys came to the NBA, you never called each other twin. But now, that's what you refer to each other as. Tell me about this story.

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: Once we got to NBA everybody started calling us twin so we would like troll and be like, oh yeah, twin, twin, twin, twin, twin. And then it just became like the lingo. That's how we address each other nowadays.
